   125	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   126	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   127	
   128	  const saved =
   129	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   130	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   131	
   132	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   133	
   134	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   135	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   136	
   137	  return "es";
   138	}
   139	
   140	export default function BlogPage() {
   141	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   142	  const [posts, setPosts] = useState<Post[]>([]);
   143	  const [active, setActive] = useState("Todas");
   144	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
   145	
   146	  useEffect(() => {
   147	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   148	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   149	
   150	      const next =
   151	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   152	          ? rawDetail
   153	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   154	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   155	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   156	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   157	              : null;
   158	
   159	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   160	        setLocale(next);
   161	        return;
   162	      }
   163	
   164	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   165	    };
   166	
   167	    updateLocale();
   168	
   169	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   170	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   171	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   172	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   173	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   174	
   175	    return () => {
   176	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   177	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   178	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   179	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   180	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   181	    };
   182	  }, []);
   183	
   184	  useEffect(() => {
   185	    setLoading(true);
   186	
   187	    fetch(`/api/blog-posts?locale=${locale}&limit=24`)
   188	      .then((r) => r.json())
   189	      .then((data) => setPosts(Array.isArray(data.posts) ? data.posts : []))
   190	      .catch(() => setPosts([]))
   191	      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
   192	  }, [locale]);
   193	
   194	  const t = copy[locale];
   195	
   196	  const visiblePosts = useMemo(() => {
   197	    const filtered =
   198	      active === "Todas"
   199	        ? posts
   200	        : posts.filter((p) =>
   201	            (p.category || "").toLowerCase().includes(active.toLowerCase())
   202	          );
   203	
   204	    return filtered.slice(0, 4);
   205	  }, [posts, active]);
   206	
   207	  return (
   208	    <div className={styles.page}>
   209	      <Header />
   210	
   211	      <section className={styles.hero}>
   212	        <Image
   213	          src="/images/recursos1.png"
   214	          alt={t.title}
   215	          fill
   216	          priority
   217	          className={styles.heroImage}
   218	          sizes="100vw"
   219	        />
   220	        <div className={styles.heroOverlay} />
   221	
   222	        <div className={styles.heroContent}>
   223	          <span>{t.badge}</span>
   224	          <h1>{t.title}</h1>
   225	          <p>{t.description}</p>
   226	        </div>
   227	      </section>
   228	
   229	      <main className={styles.blogWrap}>
   230	        <section className={styles.postsColumn}>
   231	          <div className={styles.titleBlock}>
   232	            <h2>{t.latest}</h2>
   233	            <div />
   234	          </div>
   235	
   236	          {loading && <p className={styles.loading}>{t.loading}</p>}
   237	
   238	          {!loading && visiblePosts.length === 0 && (
   239	            <p className={styles.loading}>{t.empty}</p>
   240	          )}
   241	
   242	          <div className={styles.postsGrid}>
   243	            {visiblePosts.map((post) => (
   244	              <a
   245	                key={post.slug}
   246	                href={post.url}
   247	                target="_blank"
   248	                rel="noopener noreferrer"
   249	                className={styles.postCard}
   250	              >
   251	                <div className={styles.imageBox}>
   252	                  {post.image && <img src={post.image} alt={post.title} />}
   253	                </div>
   254	
   255	                <div className={styles.postBody}>
   256	                  <time>
   257	                    {post.publishedAt
   258	                      ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat(t.dateLocale, {
   259	                          day: "2-digit",
   260	                          month: "short",
   261	                          year: "numeric",
   262	                        }).format(new Date(post.publishedAt))
   263	                      : ""}
   264	                  </time>
   265	
   266	                  <h3>{post.title}</h3>
   267	                  <p>{post.description}</p>
   268	
   269	                  <span>{t.more}</span>
   270	                </div>
   271	              </a>
   272	            ))}
   273	          </div>
   274	        </section>
   275	
   276	        <aside className={styles.sidebar}>
   277	          <h3>{t.categories}</h3>
   278	
   279	          <button
   280	            type="button"
   281	            className={active === "Todas" ? styles.active : ""}
   282	            onClick={() => setActive("Todas")}
   283	          >
   284	            {t.all}
   285	          </button>
   286	
   287	          {t.categoriesList.map((category) => (
   288	            <button
   289	              key={category}
   290	              type="button"
   291	              className={active === category ? styles.active : ""}
   292	              onClick={() => setActive(category)}
   293	            >
   294	              {t.categoryLabels[category]}
   295	            </button>
   296	          ))}
   297	        </aside>
   298	      </main>
   299	
   300	      <Footer />
   301	    </div>
   302	  );
   303	}

    72	const airportCountryAliases: Record<string, string> = {
    73	  ES: "spain",
    74	  CO: "colombia",
    75	  AR: "argentina",
    76	  MX: "mexico",
    77	  US: "usa",
    78	  CN: "china",
    79	  NL: "netherlands",
    80	  PT: "portugal",
    81	  AE: "uae",
    82	};
    83	
    84	function getCountryOptions(locale: Locale) {
    85	  const localeMap: Record<Locale, string> = {
    86	    es: "es",
    87	    en: "en",
    88	    zh: "zh-Hans",
    89	  };
    90	
    91	  const displayNames = new Intl.DisplayNames([localeMap[locale], "en"], {
    92	    type: "region",
    93	  });
    94	
    95	  return countryCodes
    96	    .map((code) => ({
    97	      id: code,
    98	      label: displayNames.of(code) || code,
    99	    }))
   100	    .sort((a, b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label, localeMap[locale]));
   101	}
   102	
   103	function getCountryCodeFromValue(value: string, countryOptions: Array<{ id: string; label: string }>) {
   104	  const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
   105	
   106	  return (
   107	    countryOptions.find(
   108	      (country) =>
   109	        country.id.toLowerCase() === normalized ||
   110	        country.label.toLowerCase() === normalized
   111	    )?.id || ""
   112	  );
   113	}
   114	
   115	function getAirportCountryKey(value: string, countryOptions: Array<{ id: string; label: string }>) {
   116	  const code = getCountryCodeFromValue(value, countryOptions);
   117	  return airportCountryAliases[code] || code;
   118	}

   365	type CargoMode = (typeof cargoModeOptions)[number]["id"];
   366	type FullCargoOption = (typeof fullContainerCargoTypes)[number];
   367	type LooseCargoOption = (typeof looseCargoTypes)[number];
   368	type CargoOption = FullCargoOption | LooseCargoOption;
   369	type CargoType = CargoOption["id"];
   370	
   371	type CargoRow = {
   372	  uid: string;
   373	  cargoType: CargoType;
   374	  cargoMode: CargoMode;
   375	  rowKind: string;
   376	  nameCargo: string;
   377	  image: string;
   378	  qtyCargo: string;
   379	  longCargo: string;
   380	  anchCargo: string;
   381	  altCargo: string;
   382	  volCargo: string;
   383	  infoCargo: string;
   384	  otherCargo: string;
   385	};
   386	
   387	function createCargoRow(option: CargoOption, mode: CargoMode): CargoRow {
   388	  const defaults: Partial<{ longCargo: string; anchCargo: string }> = "defaults" in option ? option.defaults || {} : {};
   389	
   390	  return {
   391	    uid: `${option.id}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
   392	    cargoType: option.id,
   393	    cargoMode: mode,
   394	    rowKind: option.rowKind,
   395	    nameCargo: option.nameCargo,
   396	    image: option.image,
   397	    qtyCargo: "1",
   398	    longCargo: String(defaults.longCargo || ""),
   399	    anchCargo: String(defaults.anchCargo || ""),
   400	    altCargo: "",
   401	    volCargo: "",
   402	    infoCargo: "",
   403	    otherCargo: "",
   404	  };
   405	}

   724	const initialForm = {

   726	  company: "",
   727	  email: "",
   728	  phone: "",
   729	  country: "",
   730	  contractDate: "",
   731

   733	  service: "",
   734	  originCountry: "",
   735	  originAddress: "",
   736	  originAirport: "",

   738	  destinationCountry: "",

   747	  cargoQty: "",
   748	  cargoLength: "",

   764	
   765	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   766	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   767	
   768	  const saved =
   769	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale") ||
   770	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale");
   771	
   772	  if (saved === "es" || saved === "en" || saved === "zh") return saved;
   773	
   774	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   775	  if (htmlLang === "es" || htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh") return htmlLang;
   776	
   777	  return "es";
   778	}
   779	
   780	export default function CotizacionPage() {
   781	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   782	  const [form, setForm] = useState(initialForm);
   783	  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
   784	  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
   785	  const [error, setError] = useState("");
   786	  const [airportCountries, setAirportCountries] = useState<AirportCountry[]>([]);
   787	  const [originAirportOptions, setOriginAirportOptions] = useState<AirportOption[]>([]);
   788	  const [destinationAirportOptions, setDestinationAirportOptions] = useState<AirportOption[]>([]);
   789	  const [originPortOptions, setOriginPortOptions] = useState<PortOption[]>([]);
   790	  const [destinationPortOptions, setDestinationPortOptions] = useState<PortOption[]>([]);
   791	  const [airportsLoading, setAirportsLoading] = useState(false);
   792	  const [portsLoading, setPortsLoading] = useState(false);
   793	  const [activeStep, setActiveStep] = useState(0);
   794	  const [stepError, setStepError] = useState("");
   795	
   796	  useEffect(() => {
   797	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   798	      const detail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   799	
   800	      const next =
   801	        typeof detail === "string"
   802	          ? detail
   803	          : detail && typeof detail === "object" && "locale" in detail
   804	            ? String((detail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   805	            : detail && typeof detail === "object" && "language" in detail
   806	              ? String((detail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   807	              : null;
   808	
   809	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   810	        setLocale(next);
   811	        return;
   812	      }
   813	
   814	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   815	    };
   816	
   817	    updateLocale();
   818	
   819	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   820	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   821	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   822	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   823	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   824	
   825	    return () => {
   826	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   827	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   828	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   829	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   830	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   831	    };
   832	  }, []);
   833	
   834	  useEffect(() => {
   835	    let alive = true;
   836	
   837	    fetch("/api/airports")
   838	      .then((response) => response.json())
   839	      .then((data) => {
   840	        if (!alive) return;
   841	
   842	        const countries = Array.isArray(data.countries) ? data.countries : [];
   843	        setAirportCountries(countries);
   844	      })
   845	      .catch(() => {
   846	        if (!alive) return;
   847	        setAirportCountries([]);
   848	      });
   849	
   850	    return () => {
   851	      alive = false;
   852	    };
   853	  }, []);
   854	
   855	  const t = copy[locale];
   856	
   857	  const countryOptions = airportCountries;
   858	
   859	  const countryLabel = (value: string) =>
   860	    countryOptions.find(
   861	      (country) => country.code === value || country.name.toLowerCase() === value.trim().toLowerCase()
   862	    )?.name || value;
   863	
   864	  const getCountryCode = (value: string) =>
   865	    countryOptions.find(
   866	      (country) => country.code === value || country.name.toLowerCase() === value.trim().toLowerCase()
   867	    )?.code || "";
   868	
   869	  const loadAirports = async (
   870	    countryValue: string,
   871	    setter: (airports: AirportOption[]) => void
   872	  ) => {
   873	    const countryCode = getCountryCode(countryValue);
   874	
   875	    if (!countryCode) {
   876	      setter([]);
   877	      return;
   878	    }
   879	
   880	    try {
   881	      setAirportsLoading(true);
   882	
   883	      const response = await fetch(`/api/airports?country=${encodeURIComponent(countryCode)}`);
   884	      const data = await response.json();
   885	
   886	      setter(Array.isArray(data.airports) ? data.airports : []);
   887	    } catch {
   888	      setter([]);
   889	    } finally {
   890	      setAirportsLoading(false);
   891	    }
   892	  };
   893	
   894	  const loadPorts = async (
   895	    countryValue: string,
   896	    setter: (ports: PortOption[]) => void
   897	  ) => {
   898	    const countryCode = getCountryCode(countryValue);
   899	
   900	    if (!countryCode) {
   901	      setter([]);
   902	      return;
   903	    }
   904	
   905	    try {
   906	      setPortsLoading(true);
   907	
   908	      const response = await fetch(`/api/ports?country=${encodeURIComponent(countryCode)}`);
   909	      const data = await response.json();
   910	
   911	      setter(Array.isArray(data.ports) ? data.ports : []);
   912	    } catch {
   913	      setter([]);
   914	    } finally {
   915	      setPortsLoading(false);
   916	    }
   917	  };
   918	
   919	
   920	  const normalizedService = form.service.toLowerCase();
   921	
   922	  const serviceMode =
   923	    ["aéreo", "air", "空运"].includes(normalizedService)
   924	      ? "air"
   925	      : ["marítimo", "ocean", "sea", "海运"].includes(normalizedService)
   926	        ? "ocean"
   927	        : normalizedService
   928	          ? "ground"
   929	          : "none";
   930	
   931	  const originPointLabel =
   932	    serviceMode === "air"
   933	      ? t.originPointAir
   934	      : serviceMode === "ocean"
   935	        ? t.originPointOcean
   936	        : t.originPointDefault;
   937	
   938	  const destinationPointLabel =
   939	    serviceMode === "air"
   940	      ? t.destinationPointAir
   941	      : serviceMode === "ocean"
   942	        ? t.destinationPointOcean
   943	        : t.destinationPointDefault;
   944	
   945	  const otherOriginPointLabel =
   946	    serviceMode === "air"
   947	      ? t.otherOriginAirport
   948	      : serviceMode === "ocean"
   949	        ? t.otherOriginPort
   950	        : t.otherOriginPoint;
   951	
   952	  const otherDestinationPointLabel =
   953	    serviceMode === "air"
   954	      ? t.otherDestinationAirport
   955	      : serviceMode === "ocean"
   956	        ? t.otherDestinationPort
   957	        : t.otherDestinationPoint;
   958	
   959	  const pointPlaceholder =
   960	    serviceMode === "air"
   961	      ? t.airportPlaceholder
   962	      : serviceMode === "ocean"
   963	        ? t.portPlaceholder
   964	        : t.pointPlaceholder;
   965	
   966	  const otherPointPlaceholder =
   967	    serviceMode === "air"
   968	      ? t.otherAirportPlaceholder
   969	      : serviceMode === "ocean"
   970	        ? t.otherPortPlaceholder
   971	        : t.otherPointPlaceholder;
   972	    const maritimeMode = serviceMode === "ocean";
   973	  const visibleCargoTypes =
   974	    maritimeMode && form.cargoMode === "full"
   975	      ? fullContainerCargoTypes
   976	      : maritimeMode && form.cargoMode === "loose"
   977	        ? looseCargoTypes
   978	        : !maritimeMode
   979	          ? cargoTypes
   980	          : [];
   981	
   982	  const selectedCargo = visibleCargoTypes.find((item) => item.id === form.cargoType);
   983	  const showMeasureBox = form.cargoRows.length > 0;
   984	  const cargoMeasureTitle = selectedCargo?.labels[locale].title || t.cargoTitle;
   985	
   986	  const lengthUnit = form.units === "metric" ? "cm" : "inch";
   987	  const weightUnit = form.units === "metric" ? "kg" : "lb";
   988	
   989	  useEffect(() => {
   990	    if (serviceMode === "air") {
   991	      loadAirports(form.originCountry, setOriginAirportOptions);
   992	      setOriginPortOptions([]);
   993	      return;
   994	    }
   995	
   996	    if (serviceMode === "ocean") {
   997	      loadPorts(form.originCountry, setOriginPortOptions);
   998	      setOriginAirportOptions([]);
   999	      return;
  1000	    }
  1001	
  1002	    setOriginAirportOptions([]);
  1003	    setOriginPortOptions([]);
  1004	  }, [form.originCountry, airportCountries, serviceMode]);
  1005	
  1006	  useEffect(() => {
  1007	    if (serviceMode === "air") {
  1008	      loadAirports(form.destinationCountry, setDestinationAirportOptions);
  1009	      setDestinationPortOptions([]);
  1010	      return;
  1011	    }
  1012	
  1013	    if (serviceMode === "ocean") {
  1014	      loadPorts(form.destinationCountry, setDestinationPortOptions);
  1015	      setDestinationAirportOptions([]);
  1016	      return;
  1017	    }
  1018	
  1019	    setDestinationAirportOptions([]);
  1020	    setDestinationPortOptions([]);
  1021	  }, [form.destinationCountry, airportCountries, serviceMode]);
  1022	
  1023	  const setValue = <K extends keyof typeof initialForm>(
  1024	    key: K,
  1025	    value: (typeof initialForm)[K]
  1026	  ) => {
  1027	    setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
  1028	    setStepError("");
  1029	  };
  1030	
  1031	  const syncFirstCargoRow = (rows: CargoRow[]) => {
  1032	    const first = rows[0];
  1033	
  1034	    return {
  1035	      cargoType: first?.cargoType || "",
  1036	      cargoQty: first?.qtyCargo || "",
  1037	      cargoLength: first?.longCargo || "",
  1038	      cargoWidth: first?.anchCargo || "",
  1039	      cargoHeight: first?.altCargo || "",
  1040	      cargoWeight: first?.volCargo || "",
  1041	      cargoInfo: first?.infoCargo || first?.otherCargo || "",
  1042	    };
  1043	  };
  1044	
  1045	  const selectCargoMode = (mode: CargoMode) => {
  1046	    setForm((prev) => ({
  1047	      ...prev,
  1048	      cargoMode: mode,
  1049	      cargoType: "",
  1050	      cargoQty: "",
  1051	      cargoLength: "",
  1052	      cargoWidth: "",
  1053	      cargoHeight: "",
  1054	      cargoWeight: "",
  1055	      cargoInfo: "",
  1056	      cargoRows: [],
  1057	    }));
  1058	    setStepError("");
  1059	  };
  1060	
  1061	  const addCargoRow = (option: CargoOption) => {
  1062	    setForm((prev) => {
  1063	      const mode = (maritimeMode ? prev.cargoMode || option.mode : "loose") as CargoMode;
  1064	      const nextRows = [...prev.cargoRows, createCargoRow(option, mode)];
  1065	      const first = syncFirstCargoRow(nextRows);
  1066	
  1067	      return {
  1068	        ...prev,
  1069	        ...first,
  1070	        cargoMode: maritimeMode ? mode : "loose",
  1071	        cargoRows: nextRows,
  1072	      };
  1073	    });
  1074	
  1075	    setStepError("");
  1076	  };
  1077	
  1078	  const updateCargoRow = <K extends keyof CargoRow>(
  1079	    uid: string,
  1080	    key: K,
  1081	    value: CargoRow[K]
  1082	  ) => {
  1083	    setForm((prev) => {
  1084	      const nextRows = prev.cargoRows.map((row) =>
  1085	        row.uid === uid ? { ...row, [key]: value } : row
  1086	      );
  1087	      const first = syncFirstCargoRow(nextRows);
  1088	
  1089	      return {
  1090	        ...prev,
  1091	        ...first,
  1092	        cargoRows: nextRows,
  1093	      };
  1094	    });
  1095	
  1096	    setStepError("");
  1097	  };
  1098	
  1099	  const cloneCargoRow = (uid: string) => {
  1100	    setForm((prev) => {
  1101	      const row = prev.cargoRows.find((item) => item.uid === uid);
  1102	      if (!row) return prev;
  1103	
  1104	      const nextRows = [
  1105	        ...prev.cargoRows,
  1106	        {
  1107	          ...row,
  1108	          uid: `${row.cargoType}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
  1109	        },
  1110	      ];
  1111	
  1112	      return {
  1113	        ...prev,
  1114	        cargoRows: nextRows,
  1115	      };
  1116	    });
  1117	  };
  1118	
  1119	  const removeCargoRow = (uid: string) => {
  1120	    setForm((prev) => {
  1121	      const nextRows = prev.cargoRows.filter((row) => row.uid !== uid);
  1122	      const first = syncFirstCargoRow(nextRows);
  1123	
  1124	      return {
  1125	        ...prev,
  1126	        ...first,
  1127	        cargoRows: nextRows,
  1128	      };
  1129	    });
  1130	  };
  1131	
  1132	  const toggleSpecialHandling = (id: string) => {
  1133	    setForm((prev) => {
  1134	      const current = Array.isArray(prev.specialHandling) ? prev.specialHandling : [];
  1135	      const next = current.includes(id)
  1136	        ? current.filter((item) => item !== id)
  1137	        : [...current, id];
  1138	
  1139	      return {
  1140	        ...prev,
  1141	        specialHandling: next,
  1142	      };
  1143	    });
  1144	
  1145	    setStepError("");
  1146	  };
  1147	
  1148	  const continueLabel =
  1149	    locale === "en" ? "Next" : locale === "zh" ? "下一步" : "Siguiente";
  1150	
  1151	  const backLabel =
  1152	    locale === "en" ? "Back" : locale === "zh" ? "返回" : "Atrás";
  1153

  1156	    setStepError("");

  1158	
  1159	  const editLabel =

  1164	      ? "Complete the required fields before continuing."
  1165	      : locale === "zh"

  1167	        : "Complete los campos obligatorios antes de continuar.";

  1170

  1172	
  1173	  const requiredMessage = (label: string) => {

  1180	  };
  1181	
  1182	  const invalidEmailMessage =
  1183	    locale === "en"
  1184	      ? "Please enter a valid email address."
  1185	      : locale === "zh"
  1186	        ? "请输入有效的电子邮件地址。"
  1187	        : "Ingrese un correo electrónico válido.";
  1188	
  1189	  const invalidPhoneMessage =
  1190	    locale === "en"
  1191	      ? "Please enter a valid phone number."
  1192	      : locale === "zh"
  1193	        ? "请输入有效的电话号码。"
  1194	        : "Ingrese un número de teléfono válido.";

  1197	    locale === "en"
  1198	      ? "Please select an airport or write another airport."
  1199	      : locale === "zh"
  1200	        ? "请选择机场或填写其他机场。"
  1201	        : "Seleccione un aeropuerto o escriba otro aeropuerto.";

  1207	        ? "请选择货物类型。"
  1208	        : "Seleccione un tipo de carga.";

  1214	        ? "提交前必须接受隐私政策。"
  1215	        : "Debe aceptar la política de privacidad antes de enviar.";
  1216	
  1217	  const isValidEmail = (value: string) =>
  1218	    /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(value.trim());
  1219	
  1220	  const isValidPhone = (value: string) => {
  1221	    const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, "");
  1222	    return digits.length >= 7 && digits.length <= 18;
  1223	  };
  1224	
  1225	
  1226	
  1227	  const blockedEmailMessage =
  1228	    locale === "en"
  1229	      ? "The email entered cannot be used. Please use a valid personal or business email."
  1230	      : locale === "zh"
  1231	        ? "输入的电子邮件无法使用。请使用有效的个人或公司邮箱。"
  1232	        : "El correo ingresado no puede ser utilizado. Use un email personal o corporativo válido.";
  1233	
  1234	
  1235	  const sanitizePhoneValue = (value: string) => {
  1236	    const clean = value.replace(/[^0-9+]/g, "");
  1237	
  1238	    if (!clean) return "";
  1239	
  1240	    const hasPlus = clean.startsWith("+");
  1241	    const digits = clean.replace(/\+/g, "");
  1242	
  1243	    return hasPlus ? `+${digits}` : digits;
  1244	  };
  1245	
  1246	  const isValidPhoneValue = (value: string) => /^\+?\d{7,18}$/.test(value.trim());
  1247	
  1248	  const isValidEmailValue = (value: string) => {
  1249	    const email = value.trim().toLowerCase();
  1250	    return /^[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}$/i.test(email);
  1251	  };
  1252	
  1253	  const isBlockedEmailValue = (value: string) => {
  1254	    const email = value.trim().toLowerCase();
  1255	    const [local = "", domain = ""] = email.split("@");
  1256	
  1257	    if (!email || !local || !domain) return true;
  1258	
  1259	    // Solo bloqueamos correos claramente falsos o temporales.
  1260	    const blockedExactEmails = new Set([
  1261	      "test@test.com",
  1262	      "test@example.com",
  1263	      "prueba@prueba.com",
  1264	      "demo@demo.com",
  1265	      "fake@fake.com",
  1266	      "correo@correo.com",
  1267	      "email@email.com",
  1268	      "a@a.com",
  1269	    ]);
  1270	
  1271	    const blockedTempDomains = [
  1272	      "mailinator.",
  1273	      "yopmail.",
  1274	      "10minutemail.",
  1275	      "guerrillamail.",
  1276	      "tempmail.",
  1277	      "temp-mail.",
  1278	      "trashmail.",
  1279	    ];
  1280	
  1281	    if (blockedExactEmails.has(email)) return true;
  1282	    if (blockedTempDomains.some((blocked) => domain.includes(blocked))) return true;
  1283	
  1284	    return false;
  1285	  };
  1286	
  1287	
  1288	  const getStepValidationError = (step: number) => {
  1289	    if (step === 0) {
  1290	      const normalizedEmail = form.email.trim().toLowerCase();
  1291	      const normalizedPhone = sanitizePhoneValue(form.phone);
  1292	
  1293	      if (!isFilled(form.name)) return requiredMessage(t.name);
  1294	      if (!isFilled(form.company)) return requiredMessage(t.company);
  1295	      if (!isFilled(form.email)) return requiredMessage(t.email);
  1296	      if (!isValidEmailValue(normalizedEmail)) return invalidEmailMessage;
  1297	      if (isBlockedEmailValue(normalizedEmail)) return blockedEmailMessage;
  1298	      if (!isFilled(form.phone)) return requiredMessage(t.phone);
  1299	      if (!isValidPhoneValue(normalizedPhone)) return invalidPhoneMessage;
  1300	      if (!isFilled(form.country)) return requiredMessage(t.country);
  1301	      if (!isFilled(form.contractDate)) return requiredMessage(t.contractDate);
  1302	      return "";
  1303	    }
  1304	
  1305	    if (step === 1) {
  1306	      if (!isFilled(form.operation)) return requiredMessage(t.operationRequired);
  1307	      if (!isFilled(form.service)) return requiredMessage(t.serviceRequired);
  1308	      if (!isFilled(form.originCountry)) return requiredMessage(t.originCountry);
  1309	      if (!isFilled(form.originAddress)) return requiredMessage(t.originAddress);
  1310	      if (!isFilled(form.originAirport) && !isFilled(form.originAirportOther)) return requiredAirportMessage;
  1311	      if (!isFilled(form.destinationCountry)) return requiredMessage(t.destinationCountry);
  1312	      if (!isFilled(form.destinationAddress)) return requiredMessage(t.destinationAddress);
  1313	      if (!isFilled(form.destinationAirport) && !isFilled(form.destinationAirportOther)) return requiredAirportMessage;
  1314	      return "";
  1315	    }
  1316	
  1317	    if (step === 2) {
  1318	      if (maritimeMode && !form.cargoMode) return requiredCargoMessage;
  1319	      if (form.cargoRows.length === 0) return requiredCargoMessage;
  1320	
  1321	      for (const row of form.cargoRows) {
  1322	        if (!isFilled(row.qtyCargo)) return requiredMessage(t.qty);
  1323	
  1324	        if (row.rowKind === "pallet" || row.rowKind === "box") {
  1325	          if (!isFilled(row.longCargo)) return requiredMessage(t.length);
  1326	          if (!isFilled(row.anchCargo)) return requiredMessage(t.width);
  1327	          if (!isFilled(row.altCargo)) return requiredMessage(t.height);
  1328	          if (!isFilled(row.volCargo)) return requiredMessage(t.weight);
  1329	        }
  1330	
  1331	        if (row.rowKind === "container" && !isFilled(row.volCargo)) {
  1332	          return requiredMessage(t.weight);
  1333	        }
  1334	
  1335	        if (row.rowKind === "other" && !isFilled(row.otherCargo)) {
  1336	          return requiredMessage(t.cargoInfo);
  1337	        }
  1338	      }
  1339	
  1340	      if (!isFilled(form.merchandise)) return requiredMessage(t.merchandise);
  1341	      if (!isFilled(form.stackable)) return requiredMessage(t.stackable);
  1342	      if (!isFilled(form.handling)) return requiredMessage(t.specialHandling);
  1343	
  1344	      if (form.handling === "special_handling" && form.specialHandling.length === 0) {
  1345	        return locale === "en"
  1346	          ? "Select at least one special handling requirement."
  1347	          : locale === "zh"
  1348	            ? "请选择至少一个特殊操作要求。"
  1349	            : "Seleccione al menos un requerimiento especial.";
  1350	      }
  1351	
  1352	      if (form.handling === "special_handling" && !isFilled(form.specialRequirements)) {
  1353	        return locale === "en"
  1354	          ? "Please detail the special handling requirements."
  1355	          : locale === "zh"
  1356	            ? "请详细说明特殊操作要求。"
  1357	            : "Detalle al máximo los requerimientos especiales.";
  1358	      }
  1359	
  1360	      return "";
  1361	    }
  1362	
  1363	    if (step === 3) {
  1364	      if (!form.privacyAccepted) return requiredPrivacyMessage;
  1365	      return "";
  1366	    }
  1367	
  1368	    return "";
  1369	  };
  1370	
  1371	  const getBlockingErrorForStep = (step: number) => {
  1372	    for (let index = 0; index < step; index += 1) {
  1373	      const validationError = getStepValidationError(index);
  1374	      if (validationError) return validationError;
  1375	    }
  1376	
  1377	    return "";
  1378	  };
  1379	
  1380	  const canOpenStep = (step: number) => !getBlockingErrorForStep(step);
  1381	
  1382	  const openStep = (step: number) => {
  1383	    if (step <= activeStep) {
  1384	      setActiveStep(step);
  1385	      setStepError("");
  1386	      return;
  1387	    }
  1388	
  1389	    const validationError = getBlockingErrorForStep(step);
  1390	
  1391	    if (validationError) {
  1392	      setStepError(validationError);
  1393	      return;
  1394	    }
  1395	
  1396	    setActiveStep(step);
  1397	    setStepError("");
  1398	  };
  1399	
  1400	  const nextStep = (step: number) => {
  1401	    const validationError = getStepValidationError(step);
  1402	
  1403	    if (validationError) {
  1404	      setStepError(validationError);
  1405	      return;
  1406	    }
  1407	
  1408	    setActiveStep(step + 1);
  1409	    setStepError("");
  1410	  };
  1411	
  1412	
  1413	  const getQuoteStepVisualState = (index: number) => {
  1414	    if (index < activeStep && !getStepValidationError(index)) return "complete";
  1415	    if (index === activeStep && getStepValidationError(index)) return "missing";
  1416	    if (index === activeStep) return "active";
  1417	    if (index > activeStep && !canOpenStep(index)) return "locked";
  1418	
  1419	    return "pending";
  1420	  };
  1421	
  1422	  const getQuoteStepVisualLabel = (index: number) => {
  1423	    const state = getQuoteStepVisualState(index);
  1424	
  1425	    if (state === "complete") {
  1426	      if (locale === "en") return `Step ${index + 1} complete`;
  1427	      if (locale === "zh") return `步骤 ${index + 1} 已完成`;
  1428	      return `Paso ${index + 1} completo`;
  1429	    }
  1430	
  1431	    if (state === "missing") {
  1432	      if (locale === "en") return "Missing data";
  1433	      if (locale === "zh") return "缺少数据";
  1434	      return "Faltan datos";
  1435	    }
  1436	
  1437	    if (state === "locked") {
  1438	      if (locale === "en") return "Locked";
  1439	      if (locale === "zh") return "已锁定";
  1440	      return "Bloqueado";
  1441	    }
  1442	
  1443	    if (locale === "en") return "Pending";
  1444	    if (locale === "zh") return "待完成";
  1445	    return "Pendiente";
  1446	  };
  1447	
  1448	
  1449	  const getVisualStepState = (index: number) => {
  1450	    
  1451	
  1452	    if (index < activeStep && !getStepValidationError(index)) return "complete";
  1453	    if (index === activeStep && getStepValidationError(index)) return "missing";
  1454	    if (index === activeStep) return "active";
  1455	
  1456	    return "pending";
  1457	  };
  1458	
  1459	  const getVisualStepLabel = (index: number) => {
  1460	    const state = getVisualStepState(index);
  1461	
  1462	    if (state === "complete") return "Completo";
  1463	    if (state === "missing") return "Falta información";
  1464	    if (state === "active") return "En curso";
  1465	
  1466	    return "Pendiente";
  1467	  };
  1468	
  1469	  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
  1470	    event.preventDefault();
  1471	
  1472	    for (let index = 0; index <= 3; index += 1) {
  1473	      const validationError = getStepValidationError(index);
  1474	
  1475	      if (validationError) {
  1476	        setActiveStep(index);
  1477	        setStepError(validationError);
  1478	        return;
  1479	      }
  1480	    }
  1481	
  1482	    if (sending) return;
  1483	
  1484	    setSending(true);
  1485	    setSent(false);
  1486	    setError("");
  1487	
  1488	    const selectedCargoLabel = selectedCargo?.labels[locale];
  1489	    const cargoRowsSummary = form.cargoRows
  1490	      .map((row, index) => {
  1491	        const base = [
  1492	          `${index + 1}. ${row.nameCargo}`,
  1493	          `Cantidad: ${row.qtyCargo || "-"}`,
  1494	          row.rowKind !== "container" ? `Largo: ${row.longCargo || "-"} ${lengthUnit}` : "",
  1495	          row.rowKind !== "container" ? `Ancho: ${row.anchCargo || "-"} ${lengthUnit}` : "",
  1496	          row.rowKind !== "container" ? `Altura: ${row.altCargo || "-"} ${lengthUnit}` : "",
  1497	          `Peso: ${row.volCargo || "-"} ${weightUnit}`,
  1498	          row.infoCargo ? `Info: ${row.infoCargo}` : "",
  1499	          row.otherCargo ? `Otro: ${row.otherCargo}` : "",
  1500	        ];
  1501	
  1502	        return base.filter(Boolean).join(" | ");
  1503	      })
  1504	      .join("\n");
  1505	
  1506	    try {
  1507	      const response = await fetch("/api/cotizacion", {
  1508	        method: "POST",
  1509	        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  1510	        body: JSON.stringify({ ...form,
  1511	          locale,
  1512	          country: countryLabel(form.country),
  1513	          originCountry: countryLabel(form.originCountry),
  1514	          destinationCountry: countryLabel(form.destinationCountry),
  1515	          origin:
  1516	            [
  1517	              countryLabel(form.originCountry),
  1518	              form.originAddress,
  1519	              form.originAirportOther || form.originAirport,
  1520	            ]
  1521	              .filter(Boolean)
  1522	              .join(" | "),
  1523	          destination:
  1524	            [
  1525	              countryLabel(form.destinationCountry),
  1526	              form.destinationAddress,
  1527	              form.destinationAirportOther || form.destinationAirport,
  1528	            ]
  1529	              .filter(Boolean)
  1530	              .join(" | "),
  1531	          cargoMode: form.cargoMode,
  1532	          cargoRows: form.cargoRows,
  1533	          cargoRowsSummary,
  1534	          specialHandling: form.specialHandling,
  1535	          specialRequirements: form.specialRequirements,
  1536	          cargo: cargoRowsSummary || (selectedCargoLabel
  1537	            ? `${selectedCargoLabel.title} - ${selectedCargoLabel.subtitle}`
  1538	            : ""),
  1539	          weight: form.cargoWeight ? `${form.cargoWeight} ${weightUnit}` : "",
  1540	          dimensions:
  1541	            form.cargoLength || form.cargoWidth || form.cargoHeight
  1542	              ? `${form.cargoLength || "-"} × ${form.cargoWidth || "-"} × ${
  1543	                  form.cargoHeight || "-"
  1544	                } ${lengthUnit}`
  1545	              : "",
  1546	          website: window.location.origin,
  1547	        }),
  1548	      });
  1549	
  1550	      const responseText = await response.text();
  1551	
  1552	      if (!response.ok) {
  1553	        let realError = responseText;
  1554	
  1555	        try {
  1556	          const parsed = JSON.parse(responseText);
  1557	          realError =
  1558	            parsed.error ||
  1559	            parsed.message ||
  1560	            parsed.status ||
  1561	            responseText;
  1562	        } catch {}
  1563	
  1564	        console.error("ERROR REAL /api/cotizacion:", response.status, realError);
  1565	
  1566	        const normalizedError = String(realError || "").toUpperCase();
  1567	
  1568	        if (normalizedError.includes("BLOCKED_EMAIL") || normalizedError.includes("FIELDS.EMAIL")) {
  1569	          setError(
  1570	            locale === "en"
  1571	              ? "The email entered cannot be used. Please use a valid personal or business email."
  1572	              : locale === "zh"
  1573	                ? "输入的电子邮件无法使用。请使用有效的个人或公司邮箱。"
  1574	                : "El correo ingresado no puede ser utilizado. Por favor, use un email personal o corporativo válido."
  1575	          );
  1576	          return;
  1577	        }
  1578	
  1579	        setError(t.error);
  1580	        return;
  1581	      }
  1582	
  1583	      window.location.href = "/cotizacion/gracias";
  1584	      return;
  1585	    } catch {
  1586	      setError(t.connectionError);
  1587	    } finally {
  1588	      setSending(false);
  1589	    }
  1590	  }
  1591	
  1592	  return (
  1593	    <div className="page-shell">
  1594	      <Header />
  1595	
  1596	      <main className={styles.page}>
  1597	        <section className={styles.hero}
  1598	        data-cotizacion-hero="true"
  1599	      
  1600	        data-cotizacion-photo-hero="true"
  1601	      >
  1602	          <div className={styles.heroOverlay} />
  1603	          <div className={styles.heroContent}>
  1604	            <span>{t.heroBadge}</span>
  1605	            <h1>{t.heroTitle}</h1>
  1606	            <p>{t.heroText}</p>
  1607	          </div>
  1608	        </section>
  1609	
  1610	        <section className={styles.quoteShell}>
  1611	          <aside className={styles.steps}>
  1612	            {t.steps.map((step, index) => (
  1613	              <button
  1614	                key={step}
  1615	                type="button"
  1616	                className={index === activeStep ? styles.stepActive : ""}
  1617	                onClick={() => openStep(index)}
  1618	                disabled={index > activeStep && !canOpenStep(index)}
  1619	                data-state={getQuoteStepVisualState(index)}
  1620	                data-step-state={getQuoteStepVisualLabel(index)}
  1621	              >
  1622	                <b>{String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</b>
  1623	                <span>{step}</span>
  1624	              </button>
  1625	            ))}
  1626	          </aside>
  1627	
  1628	          <form className={styles.formCard} onSubmit={submit}>
  1629	            <datalist id="quote-countries">
  1630	              {countryOptions.map((country) => (
  1631	                <option key={country.code} value={country.name} />
  1632	              ))}
  1633	            </datalist>
  1634	
  1635	            <datalist id="quote-origin-airports">
  1636	              {originAirportOptions.map((airport) => (
  1637	                <option key={airport.ident} value={airport.label} />
  1638	              ))}
  1639	            </datalist>

  2194	                      value={form.specialRequirements}
  2195	                      onChange={(event) => setValue("specialRequirements", event.target.value)}
  2196	                      rows={5}
  2197	                    />
  2198	                  </label>
  2199	                </div>
  2200	              )}
  2201	            </div>
  2202	
  2203	              <div className={styles.accordionActions}>
  2204	                <button type="button" className={styles.backButton} onClick={previousStep}>
  2205	                  {backLabel}
  2206	                </button>
  2207	                <button type="button" onClick={() => nextStep(2)}>
  2208	                  {continueLabel}
  2209	                </button>
  2210	              </div>
  2211	            </div>
  2212	          </section>
  2213	            <div className={styles.divider} />
  2214	
  2215	            <section className={`${styles.accordionPanel} ${activeStep === 3 ? styles.accordionOpen : ""}`}>
  2216	              <div
  2217	                className={styles.formHeader}
  2218	                role="button"
  2219	                tabIndex={0}
  2220	                onClick={() => openStep(3)}
  2221	                onKeyDown={(event) => {
  2222	                  if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") openStep(3);
  2223	                }}
  2224	                aria-expanded={activeStep === 3}
  2225	              >
  2226	                <span>04</span>
  2227	                <div>
  2228	                  <h2>{t.finalTitle}</h2>
  2229	                  <p>{t.finalText}</p>
  2230	                </div>
  2231	                <strong>{activeStep === 3 ? t.submit : editLabel}</strong>
  2232	              </div>
  2233	              <div className={styles.accordionBody}>
  2234	
  2235	            <label>
  2236	              {t.comments}
  2237	              <textarea placeholder={t.commentsPlaceholder} value={form.comments} onChange={(e) => setValue("comments", e.target.value)} />
  2238	            </label>
  2239	
  2240	            <div className={styles.legal}>
  2241	              <p>{t.legal}</p>
  2242	
  2243	              <label>
  2244	                <input type="checkbox" checked={form.privacyAccepted} onChange={(e) => setValue("privacyAccepted", e.target.checked)} required />
  2245	                {t.privacy}
  2246	              </label>
  2247	
  2248	              <label>
  2249	                <input type="checkbox" checked={form.marketingAccepted} onChange={(e) => setValue("marketingAccepted", e.target.checked)} />
  2250	                {t.marketing}
  2251	              </label>
  2252	            </div>
  2253	
  2254	              <div className={styles.accordionActions}>
  2255	                <button type="submit" disabled={sending}>
  2256	                  {sending ? t.sending : t.submit}
  2257	                </button>
  2258	              </div>
  2259	            </div>
  2260	          </section>
  2261	
  2262	            {stepError && <p className={styles.error}>{stepError}</p>}
  2263	            {sent && <p className={styles.success}>{t.success}</p>}
  2264	            {error && <p className={styles.error}>{error}</p>}
  2265	          </form>
  2266	        </section>
  2267	      </main>
  2268	
  2269	      <Footer />
  2270	    </div>
  2271	  );
  2272	}

    76	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
    77	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
    78	
    79	  const saved =
    80	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
    81	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
    82	
    83	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
    84	
    85	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
    86	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
    87	
    88	  return "es";
    89	}
    90	
    91	export default function OficinasPage() {
    92	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
    93	
    94	  
    95	  const [isMobileHeroTitle, setIsMobileHeroTitle] = useState(false);
    96	useEffect(() => {
    97	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
    98	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
    99	
   100	      const next =
   101	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   102	          ? rawDetail
   103	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   104	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   105	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   106	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   107	              : null;
   108	
   109	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   110	        setLocale(next);
   111	        return;
   112	      }
   113	
   114	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   115	    };
   116	
   117	    updateLocale();
   118	
   119	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   120	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   121	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   122	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   123	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   124	
   125	    return () => {
   126	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   127	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   128	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   129	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   130	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   131	    };
   132	  }, []);
   133	
   134	  useEffect(() => {
   135	    const query = "(max-width: 430px) and (min-height: 600px), (min-width: 500px) and (max-width: 760px) and (min-height: 650px)";
   136	    const media = window.matchMedia(query);
   137	
   138	    const update = () => setIsMobileHeroTitle(media.matches);
   139	
   140	    update();
   141	
   142	    if (typeof media.addEventListener === "function") {
   143	      media.addEventListener("change", update);
   144	      return () => media.removeEventListener("change", update);
   145	    }
   146	
   147	    media.addListener(update);
   148	    return () => media.removeListener(update);
   149	  }, []);
   150	
   151	  const t = copy[locale];
   152	
   153	  const mobileHeroTitle =
   154	    locale === "es"
   155	      ? "Presencia internacional en mercados estratégicos."
   156	      : locale === "en"
   157	        ? "International presence in strategic markets."
   158	        : "战略市场中的国际布局。";
   159	
   160	  const heroTitle = isMobileHeroTitle ? mobileHeroTitle : t.title;
   161	
   162	
   163	  const visibleOffices = offices.filter((office) =>
   164	    office.image.startsWith("/images/oficinas/")
   165	  );
   166	
   167	  return (
   168	    <div className={empresaHeroStyles.page}>
   169	      <Header />
   170	
   171	      <section
   172	        className={empresaHeroStyles.hero}
   173	        data-quienes-hero="true"
   174	        data-oficinas-hero="true"
   175	        data-aereo-hero="true"
   176	        data-service-hero-home="true"
   177	      >
   178	        <Image
   179	          src="/images/quienes%20somos/quienes2.png"
   180	          alt="Across Logistics - Oficinas"
   181	          fill
   182	          priority
   183	          sizes="(max-width: 900px) 0px, 100vw"
   184	          className={`${empresaHeroStyles.heroImage} ${empresaHeroStyles.heroImageDesktop}`}
   185	        />
   186	
   187	        <Image
   188	          src="/images/quienes%20somos/quienes2.png"
   189	          alt="Across Logistics - Oficinas"
   190	          fill
   191	          priority
   192	          sizes="(max-width: 900px) 100vw, 0px"
   193	          className={`${empresaHeroStyles.heroImage} ${empresaHeroStyles.heroImageMobile}`}
   194	        />
   195	
   196	        <div className={empresaHeroStyles.heroOverlay} />
   197	
   198	        <div className={empresaHeroStyles.heroInner}>
   199	          <div className={empresaHeroStyles.heroContent}>
   200	            <span className={empresaHeroStyles.eyebrow}>{t.eyebrow}</span>
   201	            <h1>{heroTitle}</h1>
   202	            <p>{t.description}</p>
   203	
   204	            <div className={empresaHeroStyles.actions}>
   205	              <Link href="/contacto">{t.primary}</Link>
   206	              <Link href="#oficinas">{t.secondary}</Link>
   207	            </div>
   208	          </div>
   209	        </div>
   210	
   211	        <div className={empresaHeroStyles.commandBar} data-aereo-trust="true">
   212	          {t.trust.map(([title, text]) => (
   213	            <div key={title} className={empresaHeroStyles.commandItem}>
   214	              <i aria-hidden="true">
   215	                <svg
   216	                  width="28"
   217	                  height="28"
   218	                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
   219	                  fill="none"
   220	                  stroke="currentColor"
   221	                  strokeWidth="1.7"
   222	                  strokeLinecap="round"
   223	                  strokeLinejoin="round"
   224	                >

   226	                  <path d="M3 12h18" />
   227	                  <path d="M12 3c2.3 2.5 3.5 5.5 3.5 9S14.3 18.5 12 21" />

   235	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   236	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   237	
   238	  const saved =
   239	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   240	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   241	
   242	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   243	
   244	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   245	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   246	
   247	  return "es";
   248	}

   474	export default function EmpresaPage() {
   475	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   476	
   477	  useEffect(() => {
   478	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   479	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   480	
   481	      const next =
   482	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   483	          ? rawDetail
   484	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   485	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   486	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   487	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   488	              : null;
   489	
   490	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   491	        setLocale(next);
   492	        return;
   493	      }
   494	
   495	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   496	    };
   497	
   498	    updateLocale();
   499	
   500	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   501	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   502	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   503	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   504	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   505	
   506	    return () => {
   507	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   508	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   509	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   510	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   511	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   512	    };
   513	  }, []);
   514	
   515	  const t = copy[locale];
   516	
   517	  return (
   518	    <div className="page-shell">
   519	      <Header />
   520	
   521	      <main className={styles.page}>
   522	        <section className={styles.hero} data-aereo-hero="true" data-service-hero-home="true"
   523	      >
   524	          <Image
   525	            src="/images/hero/hero-empresas.png"
   526	            alt={t.heroTitle}
   527	            fill
   528	            priority
   529	            sizes="(max-width: 900px) 0px, 100vw"
   530	            className={`${styles.heroImage} ${styles.heroImageDesktop}`}
   531	          />
   532	
   533	          <Image
   534	            src="/images/hero/hero-empresas.png"
   535	            alt={t.heroTitle}
   536	            fill
   537	            priority
   538	            sizes="(max-width: 900px) 100vw, 0px"
   539	            className={`${styles.heroImage} ${styles.heroImageMobile}`}
   540	          />
   541	
   542	          <div className={styles.heroOverlay} />
   543	
   544	          <div className={styles.heroInner}
   545	      >
   546	            <div className={styles.heroContent}>
   547	              <span className={styles.eyebrow}>{t.heroEyebrow}</span>
   548	              <h1 className={styles.title}>{t.heroTitle}</h1>
   549	              <p className={styles.subtitle}>{t.heroText}</p>
   550	
   551	              <div className={styles.actions}>
   552	                <Link href="/cotizacion" className={styles.primaryBtn}>{t.primaryCta}</Link>
   553	                <Link href="/contacto" className={styles.secondaryBtn}>{t.secondaryCta}</Link>
   554	              </div>
   555	            </div>
   556	
   557	            <div className={styles.operationCard}>
   558	              <span>{t.activeLabel}</span>
   559	              <strong>{t.activeRoute}</strong>
   560	              <p>{t.activeCargo}</p>
   561	
   562	              <div>
   563	                <small>{t.activeStatusLabel}</small>
   564	                <b>{t.activeStatus}</b>
   565	              </div>
   566	
   567	              <div>
   568	                <small>{t.activeEtaLabel}</small>
   569	                <em>{t.activeEta}</em>
   570	              </div>
   571	            </div>
   572	          </div>
   573	
   574	          <div className={styles.commandBar} data-aereo-trust="true">
   575	            {t.trust.map(([title, text]: string[], index: number) => {

   337	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   338	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   339	
   340	  const saved =
   341	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   342	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   343	
   344	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   345	
   346	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   347	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   348	
   349	  return "es";
   350	}

   352	export default function QuienesSomosPage() {
   353	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   354	  const [showFullTeam, setShowFullTeam] = useState(false);
   355	  const [isCompactHeroTitle, setIsCompactHeroTitle] = useState(false);
   356	
   357	  useEffect(() => {
   358	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   359	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   360	
   361	      const next =
   362	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   363	          ? rawDetail
   364	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   365	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   366	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   367	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   368	              : null;
   369	
   370	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   371	        setLocale(next);
   372	        return;
   373	      }
   374	
   375	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   376	    };
   377	
   378	    updateLocale();
   379	
   380	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   381	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   382	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   383	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   384	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   385	
   386	    return () => {
   387	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   388	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   389	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   390	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   391	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   392	    };
   393	  }, []);
   394	
   395	  useEffect(() => {
   396	    const query = "(max-width: 900px)";
   397	    const media = window.matchMedia(query);
   398	
   399	    const update = () => setIsCompactHeroTitle(media.matches);
   400	
   401	    update();
   402	
   403	    if (typeof media.addEventListener === "function") {
   404	      media.addEventListener("change", update);
   405	      return () => media.removeEventListener("change", update);
   406	    }
   407	
   408	    media.addListener(update);
   409	    return () => media.removeListener(update);
   410	  }, []);
   411	
   412	  const t = copy[locale];
   413	
   414	  const compactHeroTitle =
   415	    locale === "es"
   416	      ? "Logística internacional con control experto."

   419	        : "专业管控的国际物流。";

   422

   441	    ],
   442	  } as const)[locale];
   443	
   444	  return (

   446	      <Header />
   447

   237	} satisfies Record<Locale, any>;
   238	
   239	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   240	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   241	
   242	  const saved =
   243	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   244	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   245	
   246	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   247	
   248	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   249	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   250	
   251	  return "es";
   252	}

   478	export default function SostenibilidadPage() {
   479	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   480	
   481	  useEffect(() => {
   482	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   483	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   484	
   485	      const next =
   486	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   487	          ? rawDetail
   488	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   489	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   490	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   491	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   492	              : null;
   493	
   494	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   495	        setLocale(next);
   496	        return;
   497	      }
   498	
   499	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   500	    };
   501	
   502	    updateLocale();
   503	
   504	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   505	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   506	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   507	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   508	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   509	
   510	    return () => {
   511	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   512	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   513	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   514	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   515	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   516	    };
   517	  }, []);
   518	
   519	  const t = copy[locale];
   520

   335	
   336	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   337	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   338	
   339	  const saved =
   340	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   341	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   342	
   343	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   344	
   345	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   346	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   347	
   348	  return "es";
   349	}
   350	
   351	export default function RecursosPage() {
   352	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   353	
   354	  useEffect(() => {
   355	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   356	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   357	
   358	      const next =
   359	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   360	          ? rawDetail
   361	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   362	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   363	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   364	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   365	              : null;
   366	
   367	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   368	        setLocale(next);
   369	        return;
   370	      }
   371	
   372	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   373	    };
   374	
   375	    updateLocale();
   376	
   377	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   378	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   379	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   380	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   381	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   382	
   383	    return () => {
   384	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   385	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   386	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   387	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   388	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   389	    };
   390	  }, []);
   391	
   392	  const t = copy[locale];
   393	
   394	  return (
   395	    <div className={styles.page}>
   396	      <Header />
   397	
   398	      <section
   399	        className={empresaHeroStyles.hero}
   400	        data-quienes-hero="true"
   401	        data-aereo-hero="true"
   402	        data-service-hero-home="true"
   403	      >
   404	        <Image
   405	          src="/images/recursos1.png"
   406	          alt="Across Logistics - Recursos"
   407	          fill
   408	          priority
   409	          sizes="(max-width: 900px) 0px, 100vw"

   481	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   482	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   483	
   484	  const saved =
   485	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   486	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   487	
   488	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   489	
   490	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   491	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   492	
   493	  return "es";
   494	}

   719	
   720	export default function AlimentacionBebidasSectorPage() {
   721	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   722	
   723	  useEffect(() => {
   724	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   725	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   726	
   727	      const next =
   728	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   729	          ? rawDetail
   730	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   731	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   732	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   733	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   734	              : null;
   735	
   736	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   737	        setLocale(next);
   738	        return;
   739	      }
   740	
   741	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   742	    };
   743	
   744	    updateLocale();
   745	
   746	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   747	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   748	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   749	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   750	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   751	
   752	    return () => {
   753	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   754	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   755	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   756	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   757	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   758	    };
   759	  }, []);
   760	
   761	  const t = copy[locale];

   504	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   505	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   506	
   507	  const saved =
   508	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   509	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   510	
   511	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   512	
   513	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   514	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   515	
   516	  return "es";
   517	}

   743	export default function AutomocionSectorPage() {
   744	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   745	
   746	  useEffect(() => {
   747	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   748	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   749	
   750	      const next =
   751	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   752	          ? rawDetail
   753	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   754	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   755	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   756	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   757	              : null;
   758	
   759	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   760	        setLocale(next);
   761	        return;
   762	      }
   763	
   764	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   765	    };
   766	
   767	    updateLocale();
   768	
   769	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   770	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   771	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   772	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   773	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   774	
   775	    return () => {
   776	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   777	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   778	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   779	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   780	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   781	    };
   782	  }, []);

   591	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   592	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   593	
   594	  const saved =
   595	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   596	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   597	
   598	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   599	
   600	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   601	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   602	
   603	  return "es";
   604	}

   830	export default function ConsumoDistribucionSectorPage() {
   831	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   832	
   833	  useEffect(() => {
   834	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   835	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   836	
   837	      const next =
   838	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   839	          ? rawDetail
   840	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   841	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   842	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   843	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   844	              : null;
   845	
   846	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   847	        setLocale(next);
   848	        return;
   849	      }
   850	
   851	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   852	    };
   853	
   854	    updateLocale();
   855	
   856	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   857	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   858	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   859	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   860	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   861	
   862	    return () => {
   863	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   864	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   865	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   866	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   867	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   868	    };
   869	  }, []);

   311	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   312	  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
   313	    return "es";
   314	  }
   315	
   316	  const saved =
   317	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   318	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   319	
   320	  if (saved === "es" || saved === "en" || saved === "zh") {
   321	    return saved;
   322	  }
   323	
   324	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   325	
   326	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh") {
   327	    return htmlLang;
   328	  }
   329	
   330	  return "es";
   331	}

   333	function Icon({ name }: { name: IconName }) {
   334	  const common = {
   335	    width: 38,
   336	    height: 38,
   337	    viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
   338	    fill: "none",
   339	    stroke: "currentColor",
   340	    strokeWidth: 1.7,
   341	    strokeLinecap: "round" as const,
   342	    strokeLinejoin: "round" as const,
   343	    "aria-hidden": true,
   344	  };
   345	
   346	  switch (name) {
   347	    case "timer":
   348	      return (
   349	        <svg {...common}>
   350	          <path d="M12 8v5l3 2" />
   351	          <path d="M9 2h6" />

   456	export default function EnergiasRenovablesSectorPage() {
   457	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   458	
   459	  useEffect(() => {
   460	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   461	      const rawDetail =
   462	        event instanceof CustomEvent
   463	          ? event.detail
   464	          : null;
   465	
   466	      const next =
   467	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   468	          ? rawDetail
   469	          : rawDetail &&
   470	              typeof rawDetail === "object" &&
   471	              "locale" in rawDetail
   472	            ? String(
   473	                (rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale,
   474	              )
   475	            : rawDetail &&
   476	                typeof rawDetail === "object" &&
   477	                "language" in rawDetail
   478	              ? String(
   479	                  (rawDetail as { language?: unknown })
   480	                    .language,
   481	                )
   482	              : null;
   483	
   484	      if (
   485	        next === "es" ||
   486	        next === "en" ||
   487	        next === "zh"
   488	      ) {
   489	        setLocale(next);
   490	        return;
   491	      }
   492	
   493	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   494	    };
   495	
   496	    updateLocale();
   497	
   498	    window.addEventListener(
   499	      "storage",
   500	      updateLocale,
   501	    );
   502	
   503	    window.addEventListener(
   504	      "languagechange",
   505	      updateLocale,
   506	    );
   507	
   508	    window.addEventListener(
   509	      "localechange",
   510	      updateLocale,
   511	    );
   512	
   513	    window.addEventListener(
   514	      "across-language-change",
   515	      updateLocale,
   516	    );
   517	
   518	    window.addEventListener(
   519	      "across-locale-change",
   520	      updateLocale,
   521	    );
   522	
   523	    return () => {
   524	      window.removeEventListener(
   525	        "storage",
   526	        updateLocale,
   527	      );
   528	
   529	      window.removeEventListener(
   530	        "languagechange",

   535	        "localechange",
   536	        updateLocale,
   537	      );

   540	        "across-language-change",
   541	        updateLocale,
   542	      );
   543	
   544	      window.removeEventListener(
   545	        "across-locale-change",

   547	      );
   548	    };
   549	  }, []);

   504	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   505	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   506	
   507	  const saved =
   508	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   509	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   510	
   511	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   512	
   513	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   514	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   515	
   516	  return "es";
   517	}

   743	export default function FarmaceuticoSanitarioSectorPage() {
   744	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   745	
   746	  useEffect(() => {
   747	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   748	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   749	
   750	      const next =
   751	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   752	          ? rawDetail
   753	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   754	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   755	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   756	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   757	              : null;
   758	
   759	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   760	        setLocale(next);
   761	        return;
   762	      }
   763	
   764	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   765	    };
   766	
   767	    updateLocale();
   768	
   769	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   770	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   771	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   772	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   773	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   774	
   775	    return () => {
   776	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   777	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   778	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   779	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   780	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   781	    };
   782	  }, []);
   783	
   784	  const t = copy[locale];
   785	
   786	const operationalEyebrow =
   787	    locale === "es"
   788	      ? "Capacidad operativa"
   789	      : locale === "en"
   790	        ? "Operational capability"
   791	        : "运营能力";
   792	
   793	  const operationalTitle =
   794	    locale === "es"
   795	      ? "Control logístico para productos farmacéuticos y sanitarios con requisitos críticos."
   796	      : locale === "en"
   797	        ? "Controlled logistics for pharmaceutical and healthcare products with critical requirements."
   798	        : "面向具有严格要求的医药与医疗产品的受控物流。";
   799	
   800	  const operationalIntro =
   801	    locale === "es"
   802	      ? "Coordinamos operaciones para medicamentos, dispositivos médicos, muestras clínicas e insumos sanitarios que requieren condiciones específicas de transporte. Definimos cada movimiento según la sensibilidad del producto, los rangos térmicos aplicables, los tiempos de tránsito y los requisitos documentales, integrando control de condiciones, trazabilidad y coordinación hasta la recepción final."
   803	      : locale === "en"
   804	        ? "We coordinate operations for medicines, medical devices, clinical samples and healthcare supplies requiring specific transport conditions. Each movement is defined according to product sensitivity, applicable temperature ranges, transit times and documentation requirements, integrating condition control, traceability and coordination through final reception."
   805	        : "我们为药品、医疗器械、临床样本和医疗物资协调物流运营。根据产品敏感性、适用温度范围、运输时效和文件要求制定运输方案，并整合条件控制、全程追踪和最终交付协调。";
   806	
   807	  const operationalStages =
   808	    locale === "es"
   809	      ? [
   810	          {
   811	            number: "01",
   812	            eyebrow: "Validación y acondicionamiento",
   813	            title: "Cada producto preparado según sus condiciones de transporte.",
   814	            text:
   815	              "Revisamos sensibilidad, requisitos térmicos, tiempos críticos y documentación antes de definir el acondicionamiento y la solución logística.",
   816	            details: [
   817	              "Revisión de sensibilidad y rango térmico",
   818	              "Acondicionamiento según requisitos del producto",
   819	              "Validación documental previa a la expedición"
   820	            ]
   821	          },
   822	          {
   823	            number: "02",
   824	            eyebrow: "Transporte y control de condiciones",
