   502	} satisfies Record<Locale, any>;
   503	
   504	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   505	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   506	
   507	  const saved =
   508	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   509	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   510	
   511	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   512	
   513	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   514	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   515	
   516	  return "es";
   517	}

   743	export default function QuimicoSectorPage() {
   744	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   745	
   746	  useEffect(() => {
   747	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   748	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   749	
   750	      const next =
   751	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   752	          ? rawDetail
   753	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   754	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   755	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   756	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   757	              : null;
   758	
   759	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   760	        setLocale(next);
   761	        return;
   762	      }
   763	
   764	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   765	    };
   766	
   767	    updateLocale();
   768	
   769	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   770	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   771	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   772	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   773	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   774	
   775	    return () => {
   776	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   777	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   778	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   779	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   780	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   781	    };
   782	  }, []);

   503	
   504	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   505	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   506	
   507	  const saved =
   508	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   509	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   510	
   511	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   512	
   513	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   514	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   515	
   516	  return "es";
   517	}

   744	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");

   746	  useEffect(() => {
   747	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   748	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   749	
   750	      const next =
   751	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   752	          ? rawDetail
   753	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   754	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   755	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   756	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   757	              : null;
   758	
   759	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   760	        setLocale(next);
   761	        return;
   762	      }
   763	
   764	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   765	    };
   766	
   767	    updateLocale();
   768	
   769	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   770	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   771	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   772	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   773	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   774	
   775	    return () => {
   776	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   777	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   778	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   779	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);

   526	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   527	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   528	
   529	  const saved =
   530	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   531	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   532	
   533	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   534	
   535	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   536	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   537	
   538	  return "es";
   539	}

   765	export default function AduanasPage() {
   766	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   767	
   768	  useEffect(() => {
   769	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   770	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   771	
   772	      const next =
   773	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   774	          ? rawDetail
   775	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   776	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   777	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   778	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   779	              : null;
   780	
   781	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   782	        setLocale(next);
   783	        return;
   784	      }
   785	
   786	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   787	    };
   788	
   789	    updateLocale();
   790	
   791	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   792	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   793	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   794	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   795	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   796	
   797	    return () => {
   798	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   799	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   800	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   801	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   802	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   803	    };
   804	  }, []);
   805

   822	          />

   825	            src="/images/caduana.png"
   826	            alt={t.heroTitle}
   827	            fill
   828	            priority
   829	            sizes="(max-width: 900px) 100vw, 0px"
   830	            className={`${styles.heroImage} ${styles.heroImageMobile}`}
   831	          />
   832	
   833	          <div className={styles.heroOverlay} />
   834	
   835	          <div className={styles.heroInner}
   836	      >
   837	            <div className={styles.heroContent}>
   838	              <span className={styles.eyebrow}>{t.heroEyebrow}</span>

   541	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   542	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   543	
   544	  const saved =
   545	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   546	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   547	
   548	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   549	
   550	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   551	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   552	
   553	  return "es";
   554	}

   780	export default function AlmacenDistribucionPage() {
   781	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   782	
   783	  useEffect(() => {
   784	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   785	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   786	
   787	      const next =
   788	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   789	          ? rawDetail
   790	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   791	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   792	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   793	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   794	              : null;
   795	
   796	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   797	        setLocale(next);
   798	        return;
   799	      }
   800	
   801	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   802	    };
   803	
   804	    updateLocale();
   805	
   806	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   807	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   808	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   809	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   810	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   811	
   812	    return () => {
   813	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   814	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   815	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);

   372	} satisfies Record<Locale, any>;
   373	
   374	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   375	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   376	
   377	  const saved =
   378	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   379	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   380	
   381	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   382	
   383	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   384	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   385	
   386	  return "es";
   387	}

   390	  | "timer"
   391	  | "shield"
   392	  | "document"
   393	  | "tracking"
   394	  | "airport"
   395	  | "box"
   396	  | "plane"
   397	  | "diamond"
   398	  | "charter"
   399	  | "globe"
   400	  | "door"
   401	  | "gear"
   402	  | "laptop"
   403	  | "medical"
   404	  | "cart"
   405	  | "search"
   406	  | "route"
   407	  | "package"
   408	  | "truck"
   409	  | "headset";

   613	export default function CargasEspecialesPage() {
   614	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   615	
   616	  useEffect(() => {
   617	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   618	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   619	
   620	      const next =
   621	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   622	          ? rawDetail
   623	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   624	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   625	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   626	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   627	              : null;
   628	
   629	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   630	        setLocale(next);
   631	        return;
   632	      }
   633	
   634	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   635	    };
   636	
   637	    updateLocale();
   638	
   639	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   640	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   641	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   642	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   643	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   644	
   645	    return () => {
   646	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   647	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   648	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   649	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   650	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   651	    };
   652	  }, []);

   541	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   542	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   543	
   544	  const saved =
   545	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   546	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   547	
   548	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   549	
   550	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   551	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   552	
   553	  return "es";
   554	}

   780	export default function ECommercePage() {
   781	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   782	
   783	  useEffect(() => {
   784	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   785	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   786	
   787	      const next =
   788	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   789	          ? rawDetail
   790	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   791	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   792	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   793	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   794	              : null;
   795	
   796	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   797	        setLocale(next);
   798	        return;
   799	      }
   800	
   801	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   802	    };
   803	
   804	    updateLocale();
   805	
   806	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   807	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   808	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   809	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   810	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   811	
   812	    return () => {
   813	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   814	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   815	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   816	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   817	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   818	    };
   819	  }, []);
   820	
   821	  const t = copy[locale];
   822	
   823	  return (
   824	    <div className="page-shell">
   825	      <Header />
   826	
   827	      <main className={styles.page}>
   828	        <section className={styles.hero} data-service-name="e-commerce" data-service-hero-home="true"
   829	      >
   830	          <Image
   831	            src="/images/heroecommerce.png"
   832	            alt={t.heroTitle}
   833	            fill
   834	            priority
   835	            sizes="(max-width: 900px) 0px, 100vw"
   836	            className={`${styles.heroImage} ${styles.heroImageDesktop}`}
   837	          />
   838	
   839	          <Image
   840	            src="/images/ecommerce.png"
   841	            alt={t.heroTitle}
   842	            fill
   843	            priority
   844	            sizes="(max-width: 900px) 100vw, 0px"
   845	            className={`${styles.heroImage} ${styles.heroImageMobile}`}
   846	          />
   847	
   848	          <div className={styles.heroOverlay} />
   849	
   850	          <div className={styles.heroInner}
   851	      >
   852	            <div className={styles.heroContent}>
   853	              <span className={styles.eyebrow}>{t.heroEyebrow}</span>
   854	              <h1 className={styles.title}>{t.heroTitle}</h1>
   855	              <p className={styles.subtitle}>{t.heroText}</p>
   856	
   857	              <div className={styles.actions}>
   858	                <Link href="/cotizacion" className={styles.primaryBtn}>{t.primaryCta}</Link>
   859	                <Link href="/contacto" className={styles.secondaryBtn}>{t.secondaryCta}</Link>
   860	              </div>
   861	            </div>
   862	
   863	            <div className={styles.operationCard}>
   864	              <span>{t.activeLabel}</span>
   865	              <strong>{t.activeRoute}</strong>
   866	              <p>{t.activeCargo}</p>
   867	
   868	              <div>
   869	                <small>{t.activeStatusLabel}</small>
   870	                <b>{t.activeStatus}</b>
   871	              </div>
   872	
   873	              <div>
   874	                <small>{t.activeEtaLabel}</small>
   875	                <em>{t.activeEta}</em>
   876	              </div>
   877	            </div>
   878	          </div>
   879	
   880	          <div className={styles.commandBar} data-service-trust="e-commerce">
   881	            {t.trust.map(([title, text]: string[], index: number) => {
   882	              const icons: IconName[] = ["timer", "shield", "document", "tracking"];
   883	
   884	              return (
   885	                <div key={title} className={styles.commandItem}>
   886	                  <i>
   887	                    <Icon name={icons[index]} />
   888	                  </i>
   889	                  <span>
   890	                    <strong>{title}</strong>
   891	                    <small>{text}</small>
   892	                  </span>
   893	                </div>
   894	              );
   895	            })}
   896	          </div>
   897	        </section>
   898	
   899	        <Certifications />
   900	
   901	        <section className={styles.overview}>
   902	          <div className={styles.overviewCopy}>
   903	            <span className={styles.eyebrow}>{t.overviewEyebrow}</span>

   913	              return (

   541	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   542	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   543	
   544	  const saved =
   545	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   546	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   547	
   548	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   549	
   550	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   551	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   552	
   553	  return "es";
   554	}

   783	  useEffect(() => {
   784	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   785	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   786	
   787	      const next =
   788	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   789	          ? rawDetail
   790	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   791	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   792	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   793	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   794	              : null;
   795	
   796	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   797	        setLocale(next);
   798	        return;
   799	      }
   800	
   801	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   802	    };
   803	
   804	    updateLocale();
   805	
   806	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   807	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   808	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   809	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   810	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   811	
   812	    return () => {
   813	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   814	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   815	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   816	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);

   274	} satisfies Record<Locale, any>;
   275	
   276	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   277	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   278	
   279	  const saved =
   280	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   281	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   282	
   283	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   284	
   285	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   286	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   287	
   288	  return "es";
   289	}

   292	  | "timer"
   293	  | "shield"
   294	  | "document"

   296	  | "airport"
   297	  | "box"
   298	  | "plane"
   299	  | "diamond"
   300	  | "charter"

   304	  | "laptop"
   305	  | "medical"
   306	  | "cart"
   307	  | "search"
   308	  | "route"
   309	  | "package"
   310	  | "truck"
   311	  | "headset";
   312	
   313	function Icon({ name }: { name: IconName }) {
   314	  const common = {
   315	    width: 38,
   316	    height: 38,
   317	    viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
   318	    fill: "none",

   321	    strokeLinecap: "round" as const,

   323	    "aria-hidden": true,
   324	  };
   325	
   326	  switch (name) {
   327	    case "timer":
   328	      return (
   329	        <svg {...common}>
   330	          <path d="M12 8v5l3 2" />
   331	          <path d="M9 2h6" />

   333	        </svg>
   334	      );
   335	
   336	    case "shield":
   337	      return (
   338	        <svg {...common}>
   339	          <path d="M12 3 5 6v5c0 4.4 2.8 8.3 7 10 4.2-1.7 7-5.6 7-10V6l-7-3Z" />
   340	          <path d="m9.5 12 1.8 1.8 3.7-4" />
   341	        </svg>
   342	      );
   343	
   344	    case "document":
   345	      return (
   346	        <svg {...common}>
   347	          <path d="M14 3H7a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8l-5-5Z" />
   348	          <path d="M14 3v5h5" />
   349	          <path d="M8 13h8" />
   350	          <path d="M8 17h6" />
   351	        </svg>
   352	      );
   353	
   354	    case "tracking":
   355	      return (
   356	        <svg {...common}>
   357	          <path d="M12 21s7-5.2 7-11a7 7 0 0 0-14 0c0 5.8 7 11 7 11Z" />

   360	      );
   361	
   362	    case "airport":
   363	      return (

   365	          <path d="M3 19h18" />

   374	          <path d="M2.8 6.8 8.5 5.2" />
   375	          <path d="m15.5 5.2 5.7 1.6" />
   376	        </svg>
   377	      );
   378	
   379	    case "box":
   380	      return (
   381	        <svg {...common}>

   516	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");

   518	  useEffect(() => {
   519	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   520	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   521	
   522	      const next =
   523	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   524	          ? rawDetail
   525	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   526	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   527	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   528	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   529	              : null;
   530	
   531	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   532	        setLocale(next);
   533	        return;
   534	      }
   535	
   536	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   537	    };
   538	
   539	    updateLocale();
   540	
   541	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   542	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   543	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   544	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   545	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   546	
   547	    return () => {
   548	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   549	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   550	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   551	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   552	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);

   373	} satisfies Record<Locale, any>;
   374	
   375	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   376	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   377	
   378	  const saved =
   379	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   380	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   381	
   382	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   383	
   384	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   385	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   386	
   387	  return "es";
   388	}

   615	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");

   617	  useEffect(() => {
   618	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   619	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   620	
   621	      const next =
   622	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   623	          ? rawDetail
   624	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   625	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   626	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   627	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   628	              : null;
   629	
   630	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   631	        setLocale(next);
   632	        return;
   633	      }
   634	
   635	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   636	    };
   637	
   638	    updateLocale();
   639	
   640	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   641	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   642	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   643	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   644	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   645	
   646	    return () => {
   647	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   648	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   649	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   650	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   651	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   652	    };
   653	  }, []);

   297	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   298	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   299	
   300	  const saved =
   301	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   302	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   303	
   304	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   305	
   306	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   307	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   308	
   309	  return "es";
   310	}

   536	export default function TransporteTerrestrePage() {
   537	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   538	
   539	  useEffect(() => {
   540	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   541	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   542	
   543	      const next =
   544	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   545	          ? rawDetail
   546	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   547	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   548	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   549	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   550	              : null;
   551	
   552	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   553	        setLocale(next);
   554	        return;
   555	      }
   556	
   557	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   558	    };
   559	
   560	    updateLocale();
   561	
   562	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   563	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   564	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   565	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   566	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   567	
   568	    return () => {
   569	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   570	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   571	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   572	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   573	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   574	    };
   575	  }, []);
   576	
   577	  const t = copy[locale];
   578	
   579	  return (

   593	          />
   594	
   595	          <Image
   596	            src="/images/transporte-terrestre-mobile/transporte-terrestre-mobile.png"
   597	            alt={t.heroTitle}
   598	            fill
   599	            priority
   600	            sizes="(max-width: 900px) 100vw, 0px"
   601	            className={`${styles.heroImage} ${styles.heroImageMobile}`}
   602	          />
   603	
   604	          <div className={styles.heroOverlay} />
   605	
   606	          <div className={styles.heroInner}
   607	      >
   608	            <div className={styles.heroContent}>
   609	              <span className={styles.eyebrow}>{t.heroEyebrow}</span>

     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
     4	import Header from "@/components/layout/Header";
     5	import Footer from "@/components/layout/Footer";
     6	import styles from "./Tracking.module.css";
     7	
     8	type Locale = "es" | "en" | "zh";
     9	
    10	const copy = {
    11	  es: {
    12	    badge: "TRACKING",
    13	    title: "Seguimiento de contenedores y operaciones logísticas.",
    14	    text: "Introduzca su número de contenedor o referencia de tracking para consultar el estado disponible.",
    15	    label: "Número de tracking / contenedor",
    16	    placeholder: "Ej: MSKU1234567",
    17	    button: "Consultar tracking",
    18	    empty: "Ingrese un número de tracking para realizar la consulta.",
    19	    helpTitle: "¿Necesita más información?",
    20	    helpText:
    21	      "Si no obtiene resultados o necesita asistencia sobre su operación, contacte con nuestro equipo.",
    22	    contact: "Contactar con Across",
    23	  },
    24	  en: {
    25	    badge: "TRACKING",
    26	    title: "Container and logistics operation tracking.",
    27	    text: "Enter your container number or tracking reference to check the available status.",
    28	    label: "Tracking / container number",
    29	    placeholder: "E.g. MSKU1234567",
    30	    button: "Track shipment",
    31	    empty: "Enter a tracking number to search.",
    32	    helpTitle: "Need more information?",
    33	    helpText:
    34	      "If no results are available or you need support with your operation, contact our team.",
    35	    contact: "Contact Across",
    36	  },
    37	  zh: {
    38	    badge: "货物跟踪",
    39	    title: "集装箱与物流操作跟踪。",
    40	    text: "请输入集装箱号或跟踪参考号，以查询可用状态。",
    41	    label: "跟踪号 / 集装箱号",
    42	    placeholder: "例如：MSKU1234567",
    43	    button: "查询跟踪",
    44	    empty: "请输入跟踪号进行查询。",
    45	    helpTitle: "需要更多信息？",
    46	    helpText: "如果没有结果或需要操作支持，请联系我们的团队。",
    47	    contact: "联系 Across",
    48	  },
    49	} as const;
    50	
    51	function cleanTrackingCode(value: string) {
    52	  return value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, "").toUpperCase();
    53	}
    54	
    55	export default function TrackingPage() {
    56	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
    57	  const [trackingCode, setTrackingCode] = useState("");
    58	  const [submittedCode, setSubmittedCode] = useState("default-container-code");
    59	  const [error, setError] = useState("");
    60	
    61	  useEffect(() => {
    62	    const saved = window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale") as Locale | null;
    63	    if (saved && saved in copy) setLocale(saved);
    64	
    65	    const handler = (event: Event) => {
    66	      const next = (event as CustomEvent<Locale>).detail;
    67	      if (next && next in copy) setLocale(next);
    68	    };
    69	
    70	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", handler);
    71	    return () => window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", handler);
    72	  }, []);
    73	
    74	  useEffect(() => {
    75	    const receiveShipsgoMessage = (event: MessageEvent) => {
    76	      if (!String(event.origin).includes("shipsgo.com")) return;
    77	
    78	      const containerCode = event.data?.Parameters?.ContainerCode;
    79	      if (typeof containerCode === "string" && containerCode.trim()) {
    80	        setSubmittedCode(cleanTrackingCode(containerCode));
    81	      }
    82	    };
    83	
    84	    window.addEventListener("message", receiveShipsgoMessage);
    85	    return () => window.removeEventListener("message", receiveShipsgoMessage);
    86	  }, []);
    87	
    88	  const t = copy[locale];
    89	
    90	  const iframeSrc = useMemo(() => {
    91	    return `https://shipsgo.com/iframe/where-is-my-container/${encodeURIComponent(
    92	      submittedCode || "default-container-code"
    93	    )}`;
    94	  }, [submittedCode]);
    95	
    96	  function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    97	    event.preventDefault();
    98	
    99	    const code = cleanTrackingCode(trackingCode);
   100	
   101	    if (!code) {
   102	      setError(t.empty);
   103	      return;
   104	    }
   105	
   106	    setError("");
   107	    setSubmittedCode(code);
   108	  }
   109	
   110	  return (
   111	    <div className={styles.page}>
   112	      <Header />
   113	
   114	      <main>
   115	        <section className={`${styles.hero} acrossPageHero`}>
   116	          <div className={styles.heroMedia} />
   117	          <div className={styles.heroOverlay} />
   118	          <div className={styles.heroContent}>
   119	            <span>{t.badge}</span>
   120	            <h1>{t.title}</h1>
   121	            <p>{t.text}</p>
   122	
   123	            <form className={styles.searchBox} onSubmit={submit}>
   124	              <label>
   125	                {t.label}
   126	                <div>
   127	                  <input
   128	                    value={trackingCode}
   129	                    onChange={(event) => setTrackingCode(event.target.value)}
   130	                    placeholder={t.placeholder}
   131	                    autoComplete="off"
   132	                  />
   133	                  <button type="submit">{t.button}</button>
   134	                </div>
   135	              </label>
   136	
   137	              {error && <p>{error}</p>}
   138	            </form>
   139	          </div>
   140	        </section>
   141	
   142	        <section className={styles.trackingShell}>
   143	          <div className={styles.mapCard}>
   144	            <iframe
   145	              key={iframeSrc}
   146	              src={iframeSrc}
   147	              title="Across Logistics tracking"
   148	              loading="lazy"
   149	              referrerPolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade"
   150	              allow="geolocation"
   151	            />
   152	          </div>
   153	        </section>
   154	      </main>
   155	
   156	      <Footer />
   157	    </div>
   158	  );
   159	}
